description: This Java source file defines the class StartModuleExecutionListener, which extends AbstractTestExecutionListener. It is part of the testing infrastructure for the OpenMRS project, particularly for starting and stopping modules during test execution in JUnit 5. It handles module startup via annotations, manages bean definitions, and interacts with the Spring application context.

classes.name: StartModuleExecutionListener
classes.description: Test execution listener that manages module startup and shutdown during tests, ensuring modules are loaded or unloaded properly for each test class.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares each test instance by loading specified modules and refreshing the Spring application context.

methods.name: removeFilteredBeanDefinitions
methods.description: Removes bean definitions related to openmrsProfiles before starting modules to ensure a clean state.

methods.name: afterTestClass
methods.description: Cleans up after all tests in a class by re-registering bean definitions and shutting down modules.
